name: Anant Raj Rai Campus Data Center
developer: Anant Raj Cloud / Anant Raj Limited
notes: Baxtel lists a multi-phase Anant Raj Cloud Rai campus on NH-44 in Sonepat, Haryana, with 25 acres and planned 2028 timing, describing it as under active construction. ETDatacenters reports Anant Raj's Haryana expansion roadmap across Manesar, Panchkula, and Rai, targeting 307 MW by FY32, but does not allocate MW to Rai; capacity left null.

name: Velosting Yamuna Nagar Edge Data Center
notes: Provider page says Velosting has established an edge data center at Plot No. 11, first floor, Ishwar Nagar Workshop Road, Yamuna Nagar, Haryana 135001. It reports 7 racks, carrier/ISP connectivity, NIXI interconnection, UPS, cooling, security, and disaster recovery services; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: VueNow Nadaun Data Center
notes: DCD reported VueNow held a Bhoomi Pujan before construction for a data center in Nadaun, Hamirpur district, after a local-government MoU for a Rs 450 crore facility on 24 acres. W.Media later reported the Himachal Pradesh MoU as an edge data center in Hamirpur estimated at INR 9.6 billion. Current VueNow site says the company is setting up edge data centers in Himachal Pradesh, but does not provide district status or MW.
